question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: APOGEE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Pinnacle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **“apogee”** means the highest point in the development of something; the climax or culmination. (पराकाष्ठा / शिखर)

 
 
• **Example:** The singer reached the apogee of her career after winning the international award.
 
 
 
• **“Pinnacle”** refers to the most successful point, the peak, or the highest level of achievement. (शिखर)
 
 
• **Example:** Reaching the pinnacle of the corporate ladder takes years of dedication and hard work.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word “pinnacle” is the most appropriate synonym for “apogee.”

Therefore, the correct answer is- Pinnacle

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Height** (ऊँचाई): The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

 
 
• **Example:** The height of Mount Everest makes it the tallest mountain in the world.
 
 
 
• **Valley** (घाटी): A low area of land between hills or mountains.
 
 
• **Example:** The river flows through a beautiful valley surrounded by mountains.
 
 
 
• **Foot** (पैर / तल): The lowest part or bottom of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The village is located at the foot of the hill.
